Hi Everyone,

I am happy to start the VOTE thread to release ${PROJECT_NAME} ${VERSION}!

Release notes for the release are here:
https://github.com/${REPO_SLUG}/releases/tag/${TAG}

The tag for this release is:
https://github.com/${REPO_SLUG}/releases/tag/${TAG}
Tag commit id: ${SHA}

The artifacts to be voted on are located as follows (r${DIST_SVN_REVISION}):
Source release: https://dist.apache.org/repos/dist/dev/${SVN_PROJECT}/${SVN_FOLDER}/${VERSION}/sources
Binary distribution: https://dist.apache.org/repos/dist/dev/${SVN_PROJECT}/${SVN_FOLDER}/${VERSION}/distribution

The official release is the source distribution. The plugin ZIP in the binary
distribution is a convenience binary, signed for the JetBrains Marketplace and built
from the same tagged source.

Release artifacts are signed with a key from the following file:
https://dist.apache.org/repos/dist/release/grails/KEYS

Please vote on releasing this package as: ${PROJECT_NAME} ${VERSION}.

Reminder on ASF release approval requirements for PMC members:
https://www.apache.org/legal/release-policy.html#release-approval

Hints on validating checksums/signatures (but replace md5sum with sha512sum):
https://www.apache.org/info/verification.html

Details of our release process are documented at:
https://github.com/${REPO_SLUG}/blob/HEAD/RELEASE.md

The staged artifacts can be checked out and verified in one step with the scripts
checked into the repository:

    etc/bin/verify.sh ${TAG} /tmp/grails-ij-verify

That downloads the artifacts and the KEYS file, verifies the checksums and signatures,
audits the licenses with Apache RAT, and rebuilds the plugin from the staged source
distribution to confirm it matches the staged binary.

The vote is open for a minimum of 72 hours and passes if a majority of at least
three +1 PMC votes are cast.

[ ] +1 Release ${PROJECT_NAME} ${VERSION}
[ ]  0 I don't have a strong opinion about this, but I assume it's ok
[ ] -1 Do not release ${PROJECT_NAME} ${VERSION} because...

Here is my vote:

+1 (binding)
